selection: Five predeclared family strata: first remaining axis/extent case with all operation semantics in broadcast, reduction, dot, indexing, convolution, in original manifest order. Reduction and indexing strata require a recorded unproved explicit baseline to probe synthesis beyond baseline-proved rules. Exclude pilot cases. Not representative sampling.
assistance: For the two selected mixed-operation cases, infer only broadcast descriptors and retain the other operations' captured descriptors. No guard changes. No post-result tuning.

cases.name: broadcast_add
cases.scope: Only binary addition, equal base shapes, identical broadcast maps and added extents; excludes other elementwise functions and scalar expansion.

cases.name: reduce_compose
cases.scope: Rank-three sum, inner axis 1 then outer axis 1; symbolic extents. Does not cover arbitrary combiners/initializers.

cases.name: dot_associate
cases.scope: Ordinary rank-two matrix products without batch axes; every attribute is reused explicitly.

cases.name: reverse_add_scalar
cases.scope: Only addition and a scalar broadcast; tests the compound rule directly, not a two-rule sequence.

cases.name: expr_convolution_scale_filter_bias
cases.scope: One spatial dimension with fixed kernel/output feature positions. Proves expression of explicit scale broadcasts and convolution attribute reuse; source constant and numerical-policy conditions remain in the catalog.
